primary_meaning: Evangelism, winning souls, and Christian discipleship, famously derived from Jesus calling his disciples to be fishers of men.

alternatives.meaning: Jesus Christ Himself, originating from the early Christian Ichthys acronym (Iesous Christos, Theou Yios, Soter).
The resurrection and divine deliverance (the sign of Jonah).
Eschatological judgment and the separation of the righteous from the wicked.

notes: The fish is one of the most prominent and earliest symbols in Christianity, operating both biblically as a metaphor for evangelism and historically as a secret sign and confession of faith (the Ichthys).
